named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: Journal article on civil liability for damage caused by AI in robotic medicine, focusing on UAE Federal Medical Liability Law No. 4 of 2016 and its 2019 regulations, and the 2017 EU civil law rules on robotics. It examines fault, damage, causation and compensation, and notes UAE health-sector AI adoption.
annotation.title_clean: Civil Liability Arising from Damages Resulting from the Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Profession of Robotic Medicine
annotation.title_en: Civil Liability Arising from Damages Resulting from the Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Profession of Robotic Medicine
key_provisions_or_claims: Analyses UAE Federal Medical Liability Law No. 4 of 2016 and Executive Regulations No. 40 of 2019 regarding AI use in medicine.
Reviews the EU Legal Affairs Committee 2017 report on civil law rules on robotics.
Liability elements are fault, damage and causation between error and patient harm.
Legal consequences include judicial and contractual compensation.
UAE health authorities have successfully adopted AI, e.g., X-ray residency screening and Dubai Health Authority.
